comment: Parameters 0 to 17 and 21 to 23 are declared in the source but never configured and carry no widget, so they are left untagged. The keyboards, step and pattern strips, pause, copy, octave select and the mute buttons are custom widgets rather than parameters. The pattern strip is built with nPATTERNS, which is 8 in Seq_Triad2.cpp; the first line said sixteen and was corrected. A keyboard with nothing in its own step clock jack runs from the first keyboard clock: Seq_Triad2.cpp:1047 falls back to keyboard one whenever that jack is patched.
